instruction: Marcus has sent me a message on phone regarding some amazon order. I am forgetting the details. Do as requested as per their last message.
notes: Marcus's last text asks the supervisor to order product(s) on Amazon to her home address, email him the receipt, and request the total on Venmo (inferred from the evaluation: one new amazon order with specific product/quantity at the home address, a gmail email with an attachment, and one venmo payment request to Marcus for the order total). The model reads the contact (phone number + email) and the latest message, adds the requested product to the cart, looks up the home address id and a payment card, places the order, reads the order total, downloads the receipt to the file system, emails it to Marcus as an attachment, and creates the Venmo payment request. Static init facts (contact-query, phone-of, email-of, message-from, message-about, is-home-address, username-for, token-for) only link placeholder objects to entities; their concrete values are discovered at runtime. A single requested product is modeled; if the message lists several products, repeat amazon-add-product-to-cart per product before placing the order. supervisor-complete-task takes only record parameters (no API arguments) so its precondition equals the ground goal; no answer is needed.
